Direction from Jack Heart (2026-11-23): "i will say i think postgres (new default?) vs sqlite and turning on push (which maybe we strat requiring?) should be orthogonal". Keep the database backend (Postgres vs SQLite, including whether Postgres is the new default or SQLite remains a local option) orthogonal to the ingestion mode (push vs reading from a storage source, and whether push becomes required/primary). Do not hard-couple push ingestion exclusively to Postgres or treat SQLite as bucket-scan-only.
